title: The review-record guard reads gh behind a wrapper: timeout, bash -c, sh -c, eval, and a GraphQL addComment
why: Lane review-record-provenance (session_013NEJKzUe9U19voH62VbCNA), relayed by the coordinator 13:45 CST Nov 8: the review-record guard takes only `gh` as the command word (hooks/guard_merge.py gh_call_of). It misses `timeout N gh ...`, a GraphQL addComment, and `bash -c`, `sh -c` or `eval` wrappers. The lane takes it after its stack refresh.
note: Coordinator (13:03 CST Nov 9), from lane review-record-provenance (#2440, session_013NEJKzUe9U19voH62VbCNA): folded candidate review-record-body-forms. The guard does not read a GraphQL query from stdin (`cat q | gh api graphql -F query=@-`, `< q`, `echo |`), from a shell variable (`-f query="$Q"`), from a heredoc inside `$(...)`, or from a file written in the same command. An unreadable query file passes with no note. REST bodies have the same gaps: a shell variable, `$(printf ...)` or `$(echo ...)`, stdin, and `--input -`. Decision pr-review-record lists them.
